newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank says no new info on Creditanstalt bid.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank says no new info on Creditanstalt bid.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG on Friday declined comment on possible new developments in its bid for Austrian privatisation candidate Creditanstalt as part of an Austro-Italian-German consortium.
Sources close to the talks said Austrian savings bank Die Erste had left the consortium and that fellow consortium member, Austro-Italian insurer EA Generali, would now prepare an independent offer.
Earlier, the Austrian bourse had suspended shares in Creditanstalt and EA Generali.
"We have no new information from Vienna. The talks are continuing," said a Commerzbank spokesman.

The consortium, which also includes Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana, was due to come up with an offer for Creditanstalt by midnight Friday, but their talks are thought to have been delayed by internal conflict.
The consortium is the only known bidder for the Austrian government's 70 percent stake in Creditanstalt, which it has been trying to sell for more than six years.
